notes:
Summary: enterprise contact center (global, 1.8k agents). Primary goal: deliver streaming agent-assist with hard low-latency SLOs and provable guardrails.

Environment/constraints:
- Agent desktop (web) + live call -> need tokenized streaming suggestions and inline tool-calls to Zendesk + internal CRM API.
- PII redaction required before model ingestion; retention 30 days for transcripts, 12 months for audit logs.
- Prefer VPC/private deployment for PCI/PHI tangential workloads; on-prem considered for certain EU customers.

Performance targets / scale:
- Baseline: 1500 concurrent live agents during peak; peak spikes up to ~5k concurrent for promo days.
- Latency SLOs: streaming suggestion start <= 120ms p50, <= 350ms p95, end-to-end suggestion window for short replies < 500ms.
- Throughput: 20–30 tokens/sec per agent for live suggestions; batching must not break latency SLOs.

Model / routing preferences:
- Open to 70B-class LLMs with quantized variants; want deterministic fallback (smaller local model) when capacity constrained.
- Routing policy: prefer low-cost variant during off-peak but auto-fallback to higher-fidelity hosted model for complex intents.

Quality & guardrails:
- Must supply hallucination mitigation and confidence scoring; automated rejection of suggested actions that include PHI.
- Tool-calling must show idempotency and audit trail; explicit opt-in/override by agent.
- Expect integration with Redwood Optimize to tune batching/quantization vs quality tradeoffs.

Procurement / commercial notes:
- Procurement cycle: security sign-off -> pilot -> exec approval for annual commit. Estimated ARR target for initial roll-out $250k-$600k.
- Risk: CEO financial sign-off delayed until security FAQ fully answered.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- VP Support: "We cannot push a suggestion that could leak customer data — guardrails are non-negotiable."
- Head of SRE: "We need to reproduce spike scenarios (Black Friday-like) before committing to SLA."

POC scope (agreed):
- 2-week POC: 100 live agents in pilot queue, run synthetic spike to 2.5k for 15 minutes, measure p50/p95/p99 latencies, evaluate suggestion accuracy on annotated set of 2.5k transcripts.
- Deliverables: latency report, cost per concurrent-agent estimate, API integration guide for tool-calling, security artifacts (SOC2 + ISO excerpts).

Open questions / blockers:
- On-prem network firewall rules for private control plane access (security team to provide specifics).
- Exact retention window negotiation with legal for EU customers.
- Finalize pricing for reserved capacity vs burst.

Next steps (short):
- SE (Omar) to provision test tenant and run baseline 100-agent test by 2026-03-18.
- Security to review KMS/HSM options and sign off.
- Finance to prepare draft SOW after successful POC.
